==About==

An Ostrich Fiddlehead can be found in the wild, beneath Picked {{i|Fern}}s, or, with the [[Gardening]] skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Ostrich Fiddlehead}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Ostrich Fiddlehead takes approximately 2 hours to grow. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]].
